question: Uttar Pradesh shares its international boundary with which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nepal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nepal shares an international border with the state of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Uttar Pradesh shares a 599.3 km long open border with Nepal touching seven districts.
 
• The seven districts are - Pilibhit, Lakhimpur Kheri, Bahraich, Sravasti, Balrampur, Sidhharthnagar and Maharajganj.
 
• Nepal shares a border of about 1850 km with five Indian States - Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal, and Sikkim.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• On January 26, 1950, when India became a republic, the state was given its present name, Uttar Pradesh. 
 
• The bordering areas of the state of Uttar Pradesh include:
 
 
• Uttarakhand and the country of Nepal in the north,
 
• Bihar to the east.
 
• Jharkhand and Chhattisgarh to the southeast.
 
• Madhya Pradesh to the south.
 
• Rajasthan, Haryana, and NCT of Delhi to the west.
